notes.subject: חפשי
notes.rationale: 'free/among' (KJV) vs 'set apart' (JPS) vs 'forsaken' (BSB) — the word normally means released from bondage, here it reads as abandoned.

notes.subject: graun bilong ol
notes.rationale: קבר is 'grave/sepulchre', rendered with the Tok Pisin burial idiom 'graun bilong ol'.

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: The speaker turns to address Yahwe directly ('yu no tingim ol moa').

translation: Long ol man i dai pinis mi stap wanpela i no gat wanpela long lukautim mi, olsem ol man ol i kilim i slip long graun bilong ol, we yu no tingim ⟨את⟩ ol moa, na ol i katim ⟨את⟩ ol i go ausait long han bilong yu.
